# Contributing to TerminalOne

TerminalOne is a **single-maintainer project**. External pull requests are not being merged at this time.

## Bug Reports and Feature Requests

Bug reports and feature requests are **welcome** via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/CaptainPhantasy/TerminalOne/issues).

When filing an issue, include:

- **Expected behavior** — what should have happened
- **Actual behavior** — what actually happened
- **Steps to reproduce** — exact commands or actions
- **Environment:**
  - TerminalOne version (check `package.json`)
  - Operating system and version
  - Node.js version (`node --version`)
  - Browser and version (if applicable)

## Questions and Discussions

Questions are also welcome via GitHub Issues. There are no bad questions.

## Local Development

If you want to run TerminalOne locally to test or explore:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CaptainPhantasy/TerminalOne.git
cd TerminalOne
npm install
npm start
```

The terminal will be available at `http://localhost:11001`.

Run the test suite:

```bash
npm test
```

## Code of Conduct

Be respectful. Assume good faith. If someone is trying, meet them where they are.

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
